parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description: The sharing type of the parameter.

parameters.name: WithDecryption
parameters.description: Specifies whether to decrypt the parameter value. The Value field in the response is returned only when this parameter is set to true. Otherwise, the Value field is empty.
